question: Can a generic native-style causal learner acquire two-parent foundational relations, autonomously choose informative interventions, and discover unfamiliar three-parent rules more accurately after 16 actions than equally informed passive and alternative active controls?
hypothesis: A posterior-driven active probing mechanism grounded in acquired foundational relations will select more informative action-consequence experiences than frozen random probes or naive coverage, yielding more accurate held causal predictions without reading hidden rule identities. A similarly informed exact-family Bayesian active reference may tie or beat it; superiority is NOT assumed.
predecessor_evidence: Issue #1088: user conditional admission of independently qualified beneficial foundation learning to Yggdrasil actual native model, not automatic main merge.

FKP-02 PR #1091 qualified G29/cross-platform at 423432ca81eb76f302c4eb75dde88c7f49e8e2bc. Structured selector DEV exact-vector accuracy 0.25830 vs unprimed 0.26270; symbolic family-aware 0.75293: negative, frozen.
FKP-02 strong source headroom DEV passed 16-vs-64 observed-action identifiability. FKP-03 is a NEW source and policy question; must not reuse held evaluator as independent scientific evidence.
Existing Yggdrasil main native PublicCausalCells at main has 16 addresses, 128 learned bytes; research-only code is NOT a native model update.

frozen_design.split: 12 public binary input variables, 1 public binary consequence, 64 unique source-public candidate interventions per new world; fixed 128 disjoint unseen held actions per world. Historical foundation laws use only AND2/OR2/XOR2/NAND2 with unknown parent pairs and no gate labels; held new worlds use unknown MUX3 or majority3 with unknown parent triplet and unknown family. Source hidden law is derived from HMAC: protected seeds require external secret owner key (32+ bytes) never exposed to model or repo. Public DEV law uses a separate published key. All learners receive same prior history and access to 64 candidates, but select up to 16 queries by different policies; action-count matched, information content allowed to differ as the measured effect of intervention choice.
frozen_design.ordering: Before outcomes are sampled, freeze source-public 64 query pool and 128 distinct unseen held inputs from independent deterministic streams. Four policies: information-balance/entropy greedy with learned-rule grammar, frozen random passive order, coverage-greedy public-input-only, and strong known-family Bayesian entropy greedy; all may select 16 source actions, and are evaluated on identical underlying held worlds. Also run a same-action transcript replay for a known-family exact Bayesian predictor to separate action selection from inference.
frozen_design.data_budget: Initial public foundation: 256 worlds x64 real actions = 16,384 observed action-consequence pairs for every arm. In each new world: exactly 16 distinct causal interventions, one observed consequence per intervention, 128 unseen held predictions; no held labels in updates. All arms may use identical historical episodes; candidate public query pool size 64 is fixed.
frozen_design.compute_budget: No model APIs/GPU/paid endpoints. Original source and Python 3.12 stdlib only. Each arm at most 16 source consequence actions/world, fixed hypothesis grammar of max 220 unordered triplets x218 genuinely three-parent Boolean truth tables = 47,960 hypotheses; at most 64 candidate actions/scoring step, 16 updates. Record whole-foundation acquisition, policy-selection+fit+holdout costs, live/serialized memory, peak RSS and all search-state bytes. Full matched-compute superiority cannot be claimed until equal budgets and truly trained conventional baselines are separately qualified.
frozen_design.capacity: Source: 12 binary inputs, 1 effect bit, 64 public action choices, 16 intervention consequences, 128 held labels. Learner: exactly 4 learned historical two-input gate types (unless provenance shows actual different), generic closure to 256 possible 3-input truth-table values; restrict to 218 functions dependent on all 3 input vars. Fixed posterior over all 220 parent triples x218 functions. No hidden target-family, parent names or law labels in learner.
frozen_design.evaluator: Exact held single-effect classification accuracy, 16 DEV worlds x128 held =2048 probes, with source DEV result only. Hidden held answers only read after all arms' predictions are sealed. Report pre/post entropy proxies and action overlap, per-family, calibration, abstention, cold serialized model-state equivalence, action-count and whole-process cost. On protected new worlds, evaluator is independent owner-owned process and key remains external.
frozen_design.source_identifiability_preflight: DEV-only confirm authentic action-consequence effects and distinct outcomes for at least one candidate policy. Report whether strong correctly trained/known-family Bayesian reference has headroom at 16 versus 64 consequences; if all controls saturate, SOURCE_NO_HEADROOM and stop without primary.
frozen_design.first_use_guard: No protected primary, negative or retention first-use until independent evaluator/source/code hashes and owner-scoped permission; DO NOT insert owner key into CI/GitHub, prompts or learner API. This preregistration is source-only research authorization not owner scientific first-use.

controls: B: acquired-foundation generic 3-input posterior with active information-balance action selection, fixed sixteen interventions.
C: SAME posterior/program bank/foundation and all resource limits, but frozen random action selection on the public candidate pool.
D: SAME posterior/program bank/foundation but input-coverage-greedy action selection on the public pool without outcome posterior, to isolate whether information gain exceeds geometric coverage.

E: strong exact-family Bayesian active entropy learner supplied the source's MUX3/MAJ3 candidate families, not target identity; disclose its *stronger structural information* and use as ceiling, not matched-information superiority claim.

F: identical candidate B's selected action/consequence transcript passed to strong exact-family Bayesian inference with no extra queries, to isolate whether selecting good actions helps a stronger interpreter.

G: all possible 3-input Boolean truth tables preloaded without foundation acquisition but same hypothesis space and active policy: diagnostic ablation of acquisition cost vs prior source structure (not evidence of an uneducated human-like learner).
H: frozen uniform/prior beta baseline + optional genuinely trained conventional learner given same information/actions and fit budget, required before scientific first-use or admission.
metrics: Paired (by world) B held exact accuracy vs random C and geometric coverage D. Gate: >=0.05 absolute gain over BOTH, positive 95% paired bootstrap CI lower bound (10,000 draws fixed seed 9090), nonregression on each unseen operator family.
B vs equal-information G with fully accounted acquisition cost, prior format and accuracy: no foundation benefit if they tie.
B vs strongest eligible exact-family active E and matched-action F, both receiving more specific source-family hypothesis space, with accurate disclosure of stronger info.

Actual observed 16 source actions per arm, posterior surviving hypotheses, action overlap, calibration/false certainty, cold restore exactness, prior foundation retention and all compute/capacity/cost.
A priori STOP/NO_GO if ineffective or tied: preserve DEV negative without retraining or changing exposed DEV thresholds; protect primary seeds and original native weights.

classification_rules.supported: DEV_POLICY_SIGNAL_ONLY if B beats C AND D by >=0.05 held binary accuracy with paired bootstrap 95% CI lower bound >0 for BOTH contrasts, is not worse on either new family, keeps exact cold restore/knowledge-retention and equal per-world action caps, and no leakage. This is NOT SCIENTIFIC_PASS; scientific admission requires stronger fully trained conventional and Bayesian controls, matched whole-process information/compute, independent new source replication and owner-first-use qualification.
classification_rules.mixed: B beats random but not coverage or strong active reference, is tied by fully preloaded grammar, or retention/cost is unqualified: MIXED_DEV, no native integration.
classification_rules.negative: B tied or worse than both random or coverage under correctly counted DEV actions, or failed preset positive thresholds: DEV_NO_GO; freeze candidate and preserve receipts.
classification_rules.invalid: Any hidden source rules read during fit/policy, incomplete 16 paid actions, extra consequences beyond budget, duplicated action, private key exposed, test/evaluator leakage, stale SHA, distorted world cohorts or changed post-result thresholds: INVALID, preserve evidence and do not call SCIENTIFIC_PASS.
classification_rules.integration: No direct main-model merge. Any scientifically qualified beneficial active rule-learning mechanism must later be implemented as minimum-change native cell/memory/routing update, verified on full Linux/Windows regression, G29, cold retention and independent Yggdrasil-owner accepted-state checks.

prohibited_after_primary_run: use source-private law names or parents in candidate
preregistration_note: Commit this preregistration as sole first commit before source, code, results. Research-only; execution and admission remain scoped independently. FKP-01 and FKP-02 negative variants remain frozen.
